Your driver's details reach you before the trip, and our office number works 24×7 for the days you are on the road.

sections.h2: Roads, passes and seasons to know
sections.text: Rohtang Pass is closed from roughly November to May; the Atal Tunnel keeps Manali–Lahaul open year-round. Hill roads mean 30–40 km/h (20–25 mph) averages — we plan days around that, not around the map distance.

faqs: How much does a private driver in India cost?
It depends on the car, the season and how many nights you travel. Send us your route and dates and we reply with a day-by-day plan and a US-dollar quote; a 20% deposit locks it.
Is the driver also a guide?
No — drivers drive and help with logistics. For monuments we add licensed local guides on request.
Can I change the route during the trip?
Yes, within the same number of days and region; extra kilometres or nights are quoted on the spot.
Do I pay the driver anything directly?
No. Fuel, tolls, parking, taxes and the driver's own stay are in the price. Tips are optional.
How do I pay from abroad?
By card through Razorpay (international cards accepted) or PayPal. The balance is due before the trip.
Cancel within 48 hours of paying the deposit for a full refund. After that, the deposit holds your dates; see our booking policy.
